q: What did BEE's MSME energy mapping study cover, and is my sector included?
title: BEE MSME energy mapping study
short: BEE mapped energy use in 55 MSME clusters with more than 550 detailed audits across foundry, forging, paper, steel re-rolling, pharma, bricks, glass and refractory, chemicals, food processing, textiles and leather. A further 15 clusters in textiles, food processing and leather are being mapped with over 150 audits.
audience: MSMEs and industry associations in energy-intensive clusters

ul: Sectors: foundry, forging, paper, steel re-rolling, pharma, bricks, glass and refractory, chemicals, food processing, textile and leather.
15 clusters in textiles, food processing and leather.
Scaling up efficiency and renewable technologies in foundry, forging, steel re-rolling and paper.
Urja Mitra: an experienced certified energy auditor placed in a cluster to advise units and link them with BEE.
Support through state designated agencies for audits, demonstrations and capacity building.

p: BEE hosts reports and resources for MSMEs on its SIDHIEE knowledge portal and the SME programme pages.

senseible: Senseible gives a unit its own energy per tonne or per piece from its bills, which it can compare with what cluster studies report for its sector.
